description: NaVPO₄F crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.65-2.93 Å. There is one shorter (2.46 Å) and one longer (2.71 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-3.02 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.94 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form VO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 57-58°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.05 Å. There is one shorter (2.02 Å) and one longer (2.04 Å) V-F bond length. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form VO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 57-58°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.04 Å. There is one shorter (2.03 Å) and one longer (2.05 Å) V-F bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four VO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-50°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four VO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-51°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two V atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two V atoms.
